before: The exit is located at `(row=13, col=12)`, corresponding to cell center `(500, 640)`.
after: The exit is located at `(row=12, col=7)`, corresponding to cell center `(300, 600)`.

before: The exit is fixed at `(row=13, col=12)` and is an enterable cell.
after: The exit is fixed at `(row=12, col=7)` and is an enterable cell.

before: The maze layout, total duration of 30 seconds, movement-repeat interval of 0.15 seconds, player starting position, and exit position remain fixed for every run.
after: The maze layout, total duration of 30 seconds, movement-repeat interval of 0.15 seconds, player starting position `(row=1, col=1)`, and exit position `(row=12, col=7)` remain fixed for every run.
